description: Run one analysis route over up to 20 audio sources in a single call. Returns per-item ok/data/error; each item is metered as one call. Routes: mixlab/analyze (default), mixlab/check-target, mixlab/timeseries, mixlab/spectrum, voicelab/qa, voicelab/segments, signallab (signallab/index also works). Use for folder QA, library indexing, or checking a whole release against a loudness target. On mixlab/analyze, voicelab/qa and signallab/index each item carries measureStatus (on by default): report a proxy as an approximation, never a withdrawn field as what its name says. Sources: public https urls and/or local file paths.

bandLimit.description: For signallab/index: also return bandLimit per file, with upsampled yes, no or cannot-say (see index_signal).

contentModel.description: Content-type model: v1 (the default until 15 January 2027) or v2 (the newer small learned model).

endpoint.description: Analysis route to run for every item (default mixlab/analyze). analyze/profile and qc are not batch routes.

measureStatus.description: Add measureStatus to the answer: the status of each field. On by default; set false to leave it out.

paths.description: LOCAL audio file paths; each is read here and uploaded over a one-shot signed URL, measured by the API, and swept from storage within the hour. Combined max 20 items with urls.

round.description: Round numbers to what they are worth (dB and LUFS 2 decimals, seconds 3, ms 1, Hz 1, shares 3); same keys and types. On by default; set false for full precision.

series.description: Include the curves and arrays (a large payload). Off by default.

spectrumCalc.description: Spectrum calculation: v1 (the default until 15 February 2027) or v2 (fixes three errors found against an independent calculation; values change a little, keys do not).

speechDetector.description: Speech detector: v1 (the default until 15 January 2027) or k2 (lets a phrase run on into its soft word starts and endings, at most 100 ms per side).

target.description: For mixlab/check-target: preset id (spotify, ebu-broadcast, podcast, …) or "custom".

urls.description: Public https URLs to audio files. Combined max 20 items with paths.

name: analyze_batch
title: Batch: one analysis route over many files
